input_pins_toml:
# Canonical external input pins for the publishable `battle_bench` reference suite.
# Update this file whenever battle inputs or their source snapshots change.
format_version = 1

[oniguruma]
repo = "https://github.com/kkos/oniguruma"
commit = "f95747b462de672b6f8dbdeb478245ddf061ca53"
local_cache_dir = ".cache/upstream/oniguruma-orig"
prepare_script = "scripts/prepare-oniguruma-sources.sh"

[scanner_wrapper]
file = "benches/vscode_scanner_native.c"
source_repo = "https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-oniguruma"
source_path = "src/onig.cc"
imported_in_ferroni_commit = "ad96196d0f883dec0a552d359fa2f8f37d299962"
sha256 = "74e57ca90d0251932837195e0dbaf9194327c8b8c62f13a654a22cdec587c479"
note = "Locally extracted C scanner wrapper used by battle_bench."

[grammars]
source_repo = "https://github.com/shikijs/textmate-grammars-themes"
imported_in_ferroni_commit = "0e7016172a4563d385b362bca15308cc6225449f"
note = "Full committed grammar snapshots consumed by benches/grammar_loader.rs."

[[grammar]]
id = "typescript"
file = "benches/grammars/typescript.json"
sha256 = "e86e45f551919f50ac5e5cf89990c3520877305b35708294de5ae83c9b6ca559"

[[grammar]]
id = "css"
file = "benches/grammars/css.json"
sha256 = "eeed15521cc9e32ef9a92fa36dbf3674a6c13ba2fc20c666ef8c257e355246ec"

[[grammar]]
id = "rust"
file = "benches/grammars/rust.json"
sha256 = "41ad4b92eff153b69b65d03216d2f787861d3a23a0b4ab7a3ee8d6d6c016e34f"

[memory_workload]
scenario = "typescript_scanner_large"
kind = "deterministic synthetic TypeScript source"
repeat_blocks = 16000
driver = "line-by-line first-match scanning with full committed TypeScript grammar"
template_revision = 3

criterion_configuration.note: Each group sets these values. Criterion may extend slow cases to collect 30 samples; raw sample times are retained. Point estimates use slope where present, otherwise mean; confidence intervals are 95%.

purpose: General-purpose regex tasks: mixed validation, all-match extraction with captures, Unicode text and shared-driver email redaction.
command: cargo bench --locked --features ffi --bench battle_bench -- general_regex --noplot --save-baseline pr173-general-regex

workloads.boundary: boolean validation batch; no capture output
workloads.name: email_validation

workloads.boundary: boolean validation batch; no capture output
workloads.name: uuid_validation

workloads.boundary: boolean validation batch; no capture output
workloads.name: number_validation

workloads.boundary: all matches and raw capture bounds; materialized result vectors
workloads.name: access_log_captures

workloads.boundary: all matches and raw capture bounds; materialized result vectors
workloads.name: url_extraction

workloads.boundary: all matches and raw capture bounds; materialized result vectors
workloads.name: unicode_words

workloads.boundary: all matches plus shared redaction output builder
workloads.name: email_redaction

method_notes: Seven deterministic synthetic tasks; the three validators each repeat eight labeled inputs eight times: 32 accepted and 32 rejected. Email and UUID checks validate shape, not a complete standard.

The four text tasks process complete texts. Compilation and input generation are outside timing; capture scratch and output allocation are inside each operation. All three engines materialize the same byte-offset capture vectors.
Redaction includes the same Rust output builder after match collection for all engines; this is not a comparison of native replace APIs.
Untimed preflight checks labeled accept/reject results, every match/capture boundary against both C and regex, expected match counts, concrete access-log fields, and exact redacted bytes.
No TextMate Scanner or opt-in match cache is used. Regex objects are reused; each task runs Ferroni, then C, then regex. Fixed order and one workstation limit generalization.
The original 72-point suite was measured separately at 719a51f; do not treat the additions and original suite as one contemporaneous run or aggregate their ratios.
working_tree_note: Engine, benchmark and fixture sources match the recorded commit. Only report files were edited while measurements ran.

repeats.command: cargo bench --locked --features ffi --bench battle_bench -- access_log_captures --noplot --save-baseline pr173-general-log-repeat
cargo bench --locked --features ffi --bench battle_bench -- url_extraction --noplot --save-baseline pr173-general-url-repeat
